checks.name: pending save: edit immediately clears state and feedback
pending save: old callback cannot restore stale feedback
newer submit: older save cannot display feedback
newer submit: latest save displays exact current answers
reversed completion: old callback cannot rewrite latest feedback
repeated same answers: older submission remains silent
repeated same answers: latest submission displays
new incomplete attempt cannot be overwritten by old response
disposed section: late completion cannot show feedback
failed flush: no feedback and unsaved state retained
external same-record value change suppresses stale feedback
external record replacement suppresses stale feedback
